protocol.declaration: Corrected-input declaration after an invalid colour-selection pilot and enlarged-axis QA, before corrected-input fitting. Exploratory energies were already seen. Not blinded or preregistered; windows and models unchanged.
protocol.transformed_check: Fig6C corrected ordinate, use all recovered finite columns; T=1000/x, signal=exp(z); not raw-spectrum validation
protocol.pixel_cases: Primary window, graphical-zero baseline, T shifted +/-1.5 pixel and signal shifted +/- extraction bound; no probability/coverage meaning
protocol.input_screen: Strictly increasing spectrum T; >=5 positive pairs per leading edge; >=30 pairs whole peak; no gap filling or smoothing
protocol.comparison: Uncorrected ln(signal) slope approximates n=0; published corrected ln I - n ln theta uses n=0.02. Reference uncertainty is descriptive, not a pass criterion.
protocol.stopping_rule: One pass of four leading-edge cases, four primary engineering corners, two whole-peak diagnostics and one transformed-plot reconstruction. Preserve all outputs/failures; do not tune windows to published energy.
protocol.weights: Uniform per recovered raster column; correlated source pixels. No independent-sample CI or MC interpretation.
protocol.full_peak_role: Stress test of a single ideal zero-order state against a two-phase/broadened experimental profile; not same estimand as rising-edge reference.

result.message: Zero-order depletion profile completed; prefactor and scale are representative, not unique.

warnings: Zero-order prefactor and signal scale are representative values, not a unique fitted pair. See conditional ranges at fixed energy and normalized initial coverage one.
Depletion and parameter brackets reflect sample spacing and fixed fitted energy; they are not confidence intervals.
Zero-order information criteria count the searched depletion boundary as one parameter; the usual AICc approximation is heuristic for this nonregular edge model.
Large residual: numerical completion does not establish zero-order model adequacy.

zero_order_profile.representative_rule: Geometric midpoint of compatible prefactors, within parameter bounds.
zero_order_profile.condition: Fixed fitted energy; normalized initial coverage 1 at interval start; point-sampled ideal zero-order model. Not confidence intervals.
zero_order_profile.boundary_convention: Depletion occurs after the last occupied sample and at or before the next sample; physical prefactor lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive.
zero_order_profile.fit_status: Numerical profile search completed; review residuals and assumptions.

identifiability_diagnostics.jacobian_note: Within a fixed occupied sample set, prefactor and scale occur only as their product; local derivatives cannot identify both.
